title: CamQuake
wikitext:
CamQuake is a quakeworld client based on the code of [[ezQuake]]. It lets you playback demo files and set dynamic tracking shots for a 'camera', a tool that many QW Movie makers have long been waiting for.

== About ==
* First release: [[2006]] by [[Image:flag_de.gif]] [[Jogi]]
* Current version: Jogi's releases don't have "versions". You either have the new one or you don't.
* (Provisional) official website: https://github.com/jogi1/ezquake-source/tree/jogi/camquake/camquake
